title: Measuring Validity in LLM-based Resume Screening

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model selection and abstention rates on pairs of simulated resumes where the applicant's race is manipulated using implicit signals (racially associated names) and explicit signals (race-affiliated awards or organizational memberships).

Evaluating model selection and abstention rates on pairs of simulated resumes where the applicant's gender is manipulated using implicit signals (gendered names) and explicit signals (gender-affiliated awards or organizational memberships).
